outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of protein domains, not a plot presenting measured data.
Panel B is an epifluorescence micrograph, not a plot.
Panel C shows mean ± SEM with individual cell measurements overlaid as blue open circles.
Panel D shows mean ± SEM with individual cell measurements overlaid as yellow open circles.
Panel E shows mean ± SEM from biological replicates with individual green dots displayed.
Panel F (inhibition zone quantification) shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each biological replicate; the accompanying disk diffusion images are photographs, not plots.
Panel G is an epifluorescence micrograph, not a plot.
Panel H shows mean ± SEM with individual cell measurements overlaid as blue open circles.
Panel I shows mean ± SEM with individual cell measurements overlaid as yellow open circles.
Panel J is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
